topic: Proust and the Art of Seeing Clearly

passage.text: Proust defines the role of an original artist with the French phrase rendre visible, meaning to make visible. In his own work, he appears to help us see the world as it really is, not only its remarkable beauty and diversity, but also the way we perceive things and interact with other people. His observations suggest that we are often mistaken in our own assumptions and that it is easy to develop a biased view of another person.

source.title: Really, Here’s Why You Should Read Proust

taps.correct: In his own work, he appears to help us see the world as it really is, not only its remarkable beauty and diversity, but also the way we perceive things and interact with other people.
wrong: In his own work, he helps us see the world exactly as it really is, not only its remarkable beauty and diversity, but also the way we perceive things and interact with other people.
taps.explain: The word 'appears' softens the certainty of the claim about Proust's work.

taps.correct: His observations suggest that we are often mistaken in our own assumptions and that it is easy to develop a biased view of another person.

taps.explain: The word 'suggest' indicates the observations point toward this idea rather than proving it conclusively.

taps.prompt: What is the main idea of the text?
